description: In light of a critical new report of the Cooper Administration’s mishandling of the Hurricane Matthew recovery, House Majority Leader John Bell (R-Wayne) and Deputy House Majority Leader Brenden Jones (R-Columbus) today sent a letter to Speaker of the House Tim Moore asking him to re-authorize the House Select Committee on Disaster Relief to make sure relief is getting to those in need.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: Lawmakers Want Renewed Oversight Into Cooper Administration’s Hurricane Matthew Response
